land.text: Ur, taken by Lugal-zage-si of Umma, who 'took Uruk and Ur'

successors.note: The collective dossier sumerian-city-states books the same events from its side (loss of the plain -2500, hold on Ur -2400..-2340, gain -2340) since the me-01 fix.

capitals.name: Ur (Tell el-Muqayyar)
capitals.note: The Royal Cemetery (Puabi, Meskalamdug) belongs to this dynasty.

correction.text: the city of Ur in 'Predynastic Ur (c. 2600 – c. 2500 BC)', Early Dynastic IIIa

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe; Cliopatria has no Ur polity before Ur III. The radius is this dossier's.

correction.text: Mesannepada's hegemony: the dynasty had 'extensive influence over the area of Sumer, and apparently led a union of south Mesopotamian polities'; 'Then Uruk was defeated and the kingship was taken to Ur'. Drawn as Sumer without Lagash (40 km) and Umma (30 km), whose own keyframes (lagash_-2520, umma_-2500) cover the same years

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe for Mesannepada (r. c. 2500, 'King of Kish') and Meskiagnun (r. c. 2485–2450). A union led, not land annexed: soft. [fixer me-01: the first version drew all of Sumer, double-claiming Lagash and Umma; those two cities are now cut out and keep their own keyframes.]

correction.text: Ur after Eannatum 'defeated Ur' (c. 2450): the city under Elulu (c. 2445), Balulu and A'annepada, then under Uruk's Lugal-kinishe-dudu, 'King of Uruk and Ur' (c. 2400)

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe. The Sumerian King List: 'Then Ur was defeated and the kingship was taken to Awan' ('probably in the 25th century BC', Awan page); the Uruk hegemony of c. 2400 is hatched in the ledger.

ledger.note: 2600 BCE: the First Dynasty of Ur. The kings 'reigned c. 2600 – c. 2340 BC'; 'Predynastic Ur (c. 2600 – c. 2500 BC)' with Meskalamdug and Akalamdug (r. c. 2500); the Sumer page dates the dynasty to the 26th century by its tombs (2600–2450).

region.text: 'a union of south Mesopotamian polities': Sumer without Lagash and Umma

ledger.note: 2500 BCE: Mesannepada, 'King of Kish', leads Sumer. 'Mesannepada: r. c. 2500 BC (80 years)'; his seal bears the title 'King of Kish'; 'the final Uruk ruler, Lugal-kitun, was overthrown by Mesannepada of Ur' and 'Then Uruk was defeated and the kingship was taken to Ur'; the dynasty 'apparently led a union of south Mesopotamian polities'. A hegemony over the collective, not annexation. Mirror: sumerian-city-states records the loss (-2500) since the me-01 fix.

region.text: Sumer apart from Umma (tributary) and Ur itself, which stays a city

ledger.note: 2450 BCE: Eannatum of Lagash defeats Ur. He 'conquered all of Sumer, including Ur, Nippur, Akshak (controlled by Zuzu), Larsa, and Uruk' ('defeated Umma, defeated Ur', Lagash page); the King List's 'Then Ur was defeated and the kingship was taken to Awan' falls 'probably in the 25th century BC' (Awan page). Ur-Nanshe of Lagash had 'defeated Ur' earlier (History of Sumer page).

2450 BCE: Lagash holds Ur. Eannatum 'conquered all of Sumer, including Ur, Nippur, Akshak (controlled by Zuzu), Larsa, and Uruk'. Hatched: the city stays drawn from its own keyframe (first-dynasty-of-ur_-2450) while Lagash's keyframe lagash_-2450 leaves it out; mirror of lagash /ledger (occupation_start, Ur).
2425 BCE: Eannatum's hold lapses at his death (Enannatum I 'r. c. 2425 BC'); 'revolts often arose in parts of his empire' (Eannatum page). Bridged to the successor's accession.
2400 BCE: Ur under Uruk. Lugal-kinishe-dudu (c. 2400 BC) holds the title 'King of Uruk and Ur'; Uruk's hegemony is the collective dossier's. Hatched.
2340 BCE: the Uruk hegemony becomes Lugal-zage-si's annexation (next event).

2340 BCE: the dynasty ends. Infobox dissolution 'c. 2340 BC'; Lugal-zage-si 'took Uruk and Ur, and made Uruk his capital' (History of Sumer page); Sargon then 'was victorious over Ur in battle, conquered the city and destroyed its wall'. Ur's Third Dynasty (2112–2004) is third-dynasty-of-ur; a Second Dynasty is not on the page read.

wars.name: Mesannepada's wars
wars.outcome: Lugal-kitun of Uruk overthrown; the title 'King of Kish' taken; 'a union of south Mesopotamian polities' led from Ur.

wars.name: Eannatum's campaigns
wars.outcome: Ur defeated; Lagash master of Sumer until Eannatum's death.

wars.name: Lugal-zage-si's conquest of Sumer
wars.outcome: Ur taken; Lugal-zage-si ruled from Uruk.

certainty.note: A city and, for fifty years, a 'union' of cities; no border on any page.

notes: A state Cliopatria lacks: Ur's First Dynasty, -2600..-2340 (the page's own span), with Mesannepada's hegemony over Sumer (-2500..-2451) as a keyframe. The slug first-dynasty-of-ur is used instead of 'ur' to keep it apart from third-dynasty-of-ur. The king dates are round ('c. 2500' for three kings), so no ruler strip. The overlap with the collective sumerian-city-states is booked on both sides (loss of the plain to Ur -2500, occupation of Ur -2400..-2340, gain -2340) since the me-01 fix; Mesannepada's K1 is Sumer without the cities Lagash and Umma, which keep their own keyframes, and Lagash's conquest of Ur is a hatched occupation -2450..-2426 (mirror of lagash). Ur's defeat by Awan (King List) and by Eannatum are both placed c. 2450.
